description:
Independent Ship and Weapon Pack

A Ship and Weapon pack meant to expand the fleets and arsenals of the unaligned powers of the Persean Sector.

Requirements: None
Conflicts: None, it should work with any mods, if this proves to be untrue, please let me know.

Download Here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1l6xHPsET-bjJX35pQ2AQHmu-W9UaOMS6/view?usp=sharing
Ships Added:

Spoiler

The Behemoth - The BoxTM

The Leviathan - TheBoxTM Mk. II

The Khanyapa - WITNESSS YOUR DOOOOOOOOOM!!!

The Mokele-Mbembe - We all live in a yellow asteroid eater!

The Metacomet - Why hello there, small, undefended colony!

The Grant - I like big guns and I cannot lie!

The Burnside - The Atlas Mk. Something

The Meade - The Prometheus but full of bees.

The Chamberlain - Don't worry, they kept the pool and the 24 hour buffet!

The Sheridan - Someone please tell SafariJohn to bring back the Ogrov.

The Slugworth - Deep-space salvage, or make your own!

The Ogopogo - No! No! Not the bees!

The Sherman - Now in Blue!

The Buford - Escort Duty Rules!!!

The Sliderock - We all out of asteroids. *walks out with suspiciously asteroid shaped tummy*

The Hooker - Complimentary Blackjack!

The McClellan - Front Towards Enemy

The Koolakamba - The wolf if it decided to get a real job!

The Prodnose - Why yes, Officer, this IS legitimate salvage!

The Thomas - Hope you got flux resistant conduits, Chuddite.

The Fickelgruber - The early bird gets the worm but not if the second bird brings a gun.

The Ames - Exactly .5 Legions Trade-In value!

And Many More To Come

Weapons Included:

Spoiler

Light To Superheavy Rifles - Oh I am just such a SAP(BC) for battleships.

GRIM Reaper Torpedoes - DODGE THIS YOU BAAAAAASAAAAARDDD!

PPCs - Pew Pew Pew!

Heavy Mining Blaster - If its good enough for rocks, its good enough for ships!

Single Thermal Pulse Cannon - All lasers Onslaught anyone?

Single Assault Gun - Half a heartbeat is better than none, am I right, fellow Heggies?

Superheavy Autocannon - I miss Tiandong, man.

Whirlwind Autocannons - Give me fuel, give me fire, let me shoot down some fighters!

And More to Come

Fighters Included:

Spoiler

Flamberge Strike Fighters - The Fairchild Republic A-10 Thunderbolt II, also widely known by the nickname Warthog, is a single-seat...

Warhammer Torpedo Bombers - For very asteroid-shaped enemies of Ludd.

Changelog:

Spoiler
Version 1.5:
Possibly fixed an issue with Linux users having issues loading certain pirate skins due to a case-sensitivity error.
Ships Added:
Cruisers:
Ames
Fighters Added:
Flamberge
Warhammer

Version 1.4:
More ship tweaks, some new ships, and weapons!
Ships Added
Capitals:
Prodnose
Destroyers:
Ficklegruber
Frigates:
Thomas

Weapons Added
Large:
Superheavy Autocannon
Medium:
Whirlwind Autocannon
Small:
Light Whirlwind Autocannon

Tweaks and fixes:

Another grammar pass, I swear I went to college.
Sheridan now has a proper codex entry and description.

Version 1.3:
Some ship tweaks, fixes, and new ships!
Ships Added
Capitals:
Grant
Cruisers:
Ogopogo

Tweaks and fixes:

Mokele-Mbembe armor reduced from 1650 to 1250, advanced targeting core removed, and health reduced from 36000 to 30000. Flux Capacity reduced from 25000 to 20000 and flux distribution reduced from 1000 to 800. I'll be honest, I really over-tuned this thing. I was successfully taking on multiple paragons while running what is essentially a civilian mining hulk. It should still be tough, but not "I Win Every Fight by Myself" Tough. I have also changed two of its hybrid large mounts to ballistic large mounts in an attempt to prevent myself from slapping on 4 tachyon lances and calling it a day as well as opening the door for a more hybrid playstyle and more chances for its small and medium mounts to shine.

DP and supplies cost drop for a few civilian-grade ships. Mokele-Mbembe down to 50 from 60. Behemoth and Leviathan both to 16 from 18. Koolakamba down to 3.

Leviathan, Buford, and Meade now have proper hints for AI in their ship data file. Should be much less "rush in and die" from the escort carriers.

Mooncracker Laser should no longer show up in random loot as it should now no longer be able to drop.

Sliderock and Koolakamba ships should now properly show up in civilian fleets and Independent markets.

Koolakamba and Sliderocks' shields will now no longer instantly flux out the ship because it costs 50 to 100 times its flux dissipation to run. Whoopsie.

Slugworth ships should now show up less in direct combat fleets. Seriously they were everywhere.

All unaligned and industrial styled ships in this mod pack now have blue or yellow weapons covers respectively to prevent the eye-sore that was low-tech weapons covers on ships that aren't low tech colors.

Grammar pass. Seriously, some of the descriptions were pretty bad. This pass hopefully fixed some of it.

Version 1.2:
Attempts to fix a few bugs reported by players and some new ships and tweaks.
Ships Added:
Destroyers:
Sliderock
Frigates:
Koolakamba

Bug Fixes?:
Potential fix for bug involving ISP_Chamberlain_pirate variant file sourcing the wrong hull ID.
Potential fix for ISP_McClellan_LuddicPath.png appearing as a WEBM file.

Tweaks:

Pirate hooker should now appear in fleets and markets.

Pather McClellan and Sherman should now appear in fleets and markets.

Sheridan: Port and Starboard  medium mounts changed to face forwards at a 45 degree angle.

Mokele-Mbembe: Classified as a Civilian ship now, added Civilian Grade Hull mod. Changed 3 forward facing medium mounts to universal mounts. Militarized variant added.

Khanyapa: Two in-built mining-pod auxilleries replace two optional fighter bays. Militarized variant re-balanced with different PD layout.

Version 1.1:
More Ships and Mining Lance Rework
Ships Added:
Capitals:
Mokele-Mbembe
Cruisers:
Slugworth
Sheridan
Destroyers:
Buford

Mining Lance Reworked into Heavy Mining Blaster, a longer ranged, more powerful mining blaster with a larger magazine size as opposed to "Tachyon Lance but HE".

Added Metacomet variants to the faction spawn pool. Forgot to do that last time, whoopsie.

Version 1.0:

Annihilator MLRS

Mining Lance

Special Thanks to -
The Kitbash Database contributors; Tartiflette, bullier arthur, and JAL28
Artist and Skin Creator: Kaylee Ono
Coding from: TomatoPaste
Feedback and Spriting Tutoring: MiniDeth

If there are any issues, comments, or concerns for this modpack, please let me know and I will do my best to assist and fix things. Thank you.
